_comment: Universal interior-light definitions for ALL EHG vehicles (v2.71.0+).
_doc: Loaded (gated) alongside base.json for every brand so lights no longer live in a
brand overlay. Every light entry carries require_observed: it only materialises once
the vehicle actually reports that light bus, so a vehicle that does not have a given
IMPORTANT: the bus -> room/name mapping is FLOORPLAN-specific. The names here are a
best-guess from the known floorplans (S600/S700, ML-T 570, BMC I 680). On a different
floorplan a bus may be a different physical light, so a label can be wrong. Users can
rename the friendly name directly in HA (Settings -> Entities) without touching JSON;
contributors can remap bus<->name here. Names are FROZEN once shipped (never rename an
existing entity - that breaks dashboards; add a new alias instead).
Phase C will read the light labels dynamically from the SCU, which makes this file's
hardcoded names obsolete - until then this shared, gated, editable file is the bridge.
sensors: light_* status (binary_sensor on/off + brightness/color_temp read sensors).
lights:  keyed by bus_id; the controllable light. entity (sid 1 on/off, 2 brightness,
3 color_temp). require_observed gates creation in light.py.

sensors._doc_scaffold: v2.96.0+ — the entries below are PROVISIONAL scaffolds for EHG LightCircuit/LightGroup components not yet confirmed on a real vehicle. Every one is require_observed (never a phantom) AND enabled:false (never auto-shown). The name is the EHG-catalog function label, NOT a verified per-floorplan room. If your vehicle has one, enable the entity (Settings -> Entities) and rename it in HA, or remap here + strings.json/en.json. NEVER rename an existing shipped light.
